[[File:Martial_artist_TotG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] martial artist]]
A '''martial artist''' was a person who practiced [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]], a form of melee combat. Many do not use any weapons at all, but have trained their body to be a living weapon. However, there were some martial arts forms that did use some weapons, such as the [[Stava (skill)|Stava]] form of the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], and the [[Petranaki/Legends|Petranaki]] form of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]].

There were also schools that trained [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] martial artists on how to combine the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] into their combat form. Both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] monitored these martial arts schools for potential recruits, knowing that ideal candidates could be found among these exceptional individuals who focused their mind and body in harmony with the Force.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
